{{Quote|Whatever this thing is, it isn't taking prisoners. I witnessed it slaughter an entire platoon from my hiding place.|Anonymous Rebel engineer|<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref>}}
'''Terror Biodroids''',<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" /> also known as '''Terror Giants''',<ref name="The Force Unleashed II: Prima Guide">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> were massive [[Droid/Legends|droid]] units used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They were part of the Empire's new C-Class units and were created in [[Timira City]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] like the other units of this program. Terror Biodroids were known to fight with huge spiked arms and a variant of [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force push]].

==Characteristics==
Terror Biodroids,<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" /> also known as Terror Giants,<ref name="The Force Unleashed II: Prima Guide" /> were massive, hulking [[Droid/Legends|droids]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" /> capable of cutting through even the toughest [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. From distance, their huge [[Limb/Legends|arms]] are razor-sharp and, combined with their extraordinary speed, was incredibly deadly. <ref name="The Force Unleashed II: Prima Guide" /> Their faceplates resembled that of<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" /> the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="The Good, the Bad, and the Gorog>{{InsiderCite|121|The Good, the Bad, and the Gorog: The Art of Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II|The Good, the Bad, and the Gorog: The Art of ''Star Wars'': The Force Unleashed II}}</ref>

==History==
The Terror Biodroids were usually associated with [[Terror Trooper]]s and [[Terror Droid]]s, as they were the additional forces given by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] on the [[Battle near the Itani Nebula|assault]] to the [[Salvation (flagship)|''Salvation'']].<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" />

==Capabilities==
[[File:Terror_Biodroid_Starkiller.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Subject 1138|Starkiller]] attacks a Terror Biodroid.]]
With their massive [[Claw/Legends|claws]], they could lunge at any victim with ease while delivering a fatal blow, and have jet boosters in order to quickly charge at a target. The Terror Biodroids were also able to utilize a variant of [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force push]], which made them difficult to deal with.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" />

==Behind the scenes==
Terror Biodroids appear as a C-class unit in the [[2010]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''. The original faceplate design for the Terror Biodroids resembled that of a [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Kaleesh mask/Legends|war mask]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" /> According to the article [[The Good, the Bad, and the Gorog: The Art of Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II|''The Good, the Bad, and the Gorog'']], the development team wanted to tie the mask in with the movies by featuring one similar to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]'.<ref name="The Good, the Bad, and the Gorog /> The Terror Biodroids were omitted from the [[Wikipedia:Wii|Nintendo Wii]] version.<ref name="Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II" />
